system.effect:
You are Trained in this fighting style: its exploits are open to you, and checks its talents call for use this Constellation's Proficiency. Attack rolls themselves use your Weapons Proficiency.
You gain the Overreach action.
Overreach ◆ (stance)
You must be wielding a two-handed melee weapon.
While you are in this stance your Hits and Critical Hits deal +2 damage and your Evade drops by 2, rising to +3 damage at Expert rank, +4 at Master, and +5 at Legendary. Every talent here requires this.
